title: Convergence Green Arrow #1 of 2 DC Comics 2015 Rags Morales Cover Christy Marx
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Convergence: Green Arrow #1 of 2 (June 2015), DC Comics - part of the Convergence event. Written by Christy Marx with art by Rags Morales and Claude St-Aubin; cover by Rags Morales.

Back cover: Wrigley's 5 Ascent gum ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
